title: The Cambridge Springs Pin
setup: You backed d5 with pawns on c6 and e6 and put your queen on a5. White's queen has just attacked your knight on e4.
hint: Your queen pins the knight on c3 to the white king. With that knight frozen, what is left guarding White's bishop?
explanation:
## The Idea

Your queen on a5 pins the knight on c3 to the white king, so the bishop on g5 has a single guard, the knight on f3.

{{Nxg5}} takes the bishop anyway. If {{Nxg5}}, then {{dxc4}} clears your own pawn off the fifth rank, and the queen wins the knight back: a piece up. White's other tries lose the piece more quietly.

A pinned piece guards nothing. Check that before every capture your opponent seems to allow.
